def compute_binary_kl(p, q, eps=1e-8):
    """KL(p || q) for binary distributions [p, 1-p] and [q, 1-q]."""
    p = np.clip(p, eps, 1 - eps)
    q = np.clip(q, eps, 1 - eps)
    return p * np.log(p / q) + (1 - p) * np.log((1 - p) / (1 - q))
